name: 33rd UQ Senate Create Change Residential Scholarship
summary: Accommodation scholarship for commencing UQ students with an ATAR of 89+ who face financial hardship and live at an approved residence.
who: Domestic commencing student enrolled full-time in an approved program.
Resident at an approved accommodation provider.
Can demonstrate financial hardship with documents.
how: Apply using the online form with your QTAC reference number and evidence of financial hardship.
catches: The main round closed 9 October 2026. The second round runs 10 October to 4 December 2026.

source.label: UQ Scholarships: 33rd UQ Senate Create Change Residential Scholarship

evidence.quote: achieve a minimum Australian Tertiary Admission Rank of 89.00 (or equivalent)
